---
title: "Get involved"
description: "Propose definitions, report problems, and improve OWAS documentation."
---

## Useful contributions

Propose a metric, identify an ambiguous population or time boundary, add a worked example, or reproduce an analysis.

## Propose a change

In the source repository, open an issue with the affected page, proposed change, reason, and a small example. Use a pull request for a concrete edit. Discuss interpretation questions in GitHub Discussions when enabled by the maintainers.

Visit the [source repository](https://github.com/kmj0084/open-workforce-analytics-standard), [open an issue](https://github.com/kmj0084/open-workforce-analytics-standard/issues), or [propose a pull request](https://github.com/kmj0084/open-workforce-analytics-standard/pulls). Contribution instructions and reusable templates are included in the repository README.

## Review expectations

Keep proposals focused. Explain whether a change affects historical comparisons. Use synthetic examples instead of personal workforce records.
